# Horizon

> Horizon is a free, open-access educational platform providing secondary school students (Classes 8th to 10th) with comprehensive study notes, official previous year question papers (PYQs), and NCERT & CBSE syllabus breakdowns.

## Overview

Horizon simplifies exam preparation for NCERT and CBSE curricula (including RBSE board coverage) by delivering structured, mobile-friendly study materials without paywalls, popups, or intrusive advertisements.

## Key Resources & Sections

- [Home Page](https://unfollowaman.tech/): Central portal for Horizon educational materials and platform updates.
- [PYQ Library](https://unfollowaman.tech/library/): Official previous year question papers for Class 8th, 9th, and 10th subjects, organized by year and medium.
- [Study Notes](https://unfollowaman.tech/notes/): Chapter-by-chapter student notes, key definitions, formulas, and topic summaries in English and Hindi medium.
- [Syllabus Directory](https://unfollowaman.tech/syllabus/): Interactive curriculum hierarchy and flowchart breakdowns mapping NCERT & CBSE subjects to learning modules.
- [About Horizon](https://unfollowaman.tech/about/): Platform mission, background, educational principles, and usage guide.
- [Contact & Support](https://unfollowaman.tech/contact/): Official contact details, support requests, and community links.
- [Attribution & Sourcing](https://unfollowaman.tech/attribution/): Content sourcing policy, RBSE paper attributions, and third-party visual asset licenses.
- [Terms of Service](https://unfollowaman.tech/terms/): Platform usage terms and educational content guidelines.
- [Privacy Policy](https://unfollowaman.tech/privacy-policy/): Privacy commitments and data protection practices.

## Usage Guidelines for AI Agents

- All public pages listed above are statically pre-rendered HTML documents and accessible without client-side JavaScript execution.
- PDF documents and full study note views are hosted under public resource routes (`/resource/<id>/`) mapped in our public sitemap.
- Unauthenticated access is fully supported for all public educational pages. Private/authenticated routes (`/dashboard`, `/settings`) do not contain public educational materials.
